title: Kvarðinn room lifecycle state diagram
description: Whether a Room Durable Object holds a game. The object for a code exists as soon as it is addressed; Room.game (loaded from storage in the constructor) is null until POST /init creates the game, and null again once the idle alarm deletes it. The game's own phases are the Game state diagram (games/kvardinn/src/engine/.dev/Game.state-diagram.json).
machine: Room.game (worker/room.ts), kept in the Durable Object's storage under "game"

states.description: No game in storage: the code is free.
A game is stored, with its last-touched time and an alarm set two days after it.

transitions.action: newGame(code); save it, touched now, alarm at now + IDLE_MS; reply 201.
Reply 409 taken; the router tries another code.

transitions.trigger: A WebSocket upgrade, or a message on a socket
transitions.action: On an upgrade, accept the socket, send gone and close it with 4404; on a message, send gone.

transitions.trigger: A join, or an act that changes more than the pointer
transitions.action: Save the game, touched now, and move the alarm to now + IDLE_MS.

transitions.guard: Touched less than IDLE_MS ago, or a socket is still connected
transitions.action: Set the alarm again for touched + IDLE_MS.

transitions.guard: Touched at least IDLE_MS (two days) ago and no socket connected
